context: This scenario tests whether the evaluatee understands that the package tracks mutations transitively through nested objects. When makeReadOnly is applied to a parent object and a nested child property is subsequently read via the installed getter, the child is also made read-only, so mutations on the child are detected. Criteria focus on leveraging this package behavior correctly.

checklist.name: Apply tracking to root
checklist.description: buildMakeReadOnly and the returned makeReadOnly are used to apply tracking to the root (top-level) object only — not to child objects directly.

checklist.name: Nested mutation logged
checklist.description: After tracking the root object, mutating a property on a nested object-valued property triggers the logger.

checklist.name: Correct key and value logged
checklist.description: The logger is called with the key of the mutated nested property (not the parent key) and the new value assigned to it.

checklist.name: Source propagated to nested
checklist.description: The source string provided when tracking the root object is the same source string included in the logger call for the nested mutation.
